verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a compliance SaaS with a developer API, so a sandbox or test-tenant environment is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents one. The closest feature, the API Playground, is a query-testing tool whose requests run against the live tenant. That is the opposite of isolation from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: You can use the playground to explore the API schema, test queries and mutations, and validate responses in real time.
